regulatory_bodies: GACC (General Administration of Customs of China)

rules.name: China Compulsory Certification (CCC Mark) for Toys & Walkers
rules.title: China Compulsory Certification (CCC Mark) for Toys & Walkers
rules.directive_code: Regulations on Compulsory Product Certification / CNCA-C22-01:2020
rules.statute_citation: Regulations on Compulsory Product Certification / CNCA-C22-01:2020
rules.expected_requirement: All toys and wheeled strollers/walkers must hold China Compulsory Certification (CCC) and bear the CCC mark before customs entry.
rules.explanation: Importing or selling toys without CCC certification is strictly prohibited. Goods are denied entry at GACC ports and subject to severe administrative penalties.
rules.fix_suggestion: Obtain CCC factory audit and type test report according to GB 6675 standards and display CCC mark.

requirements.name: China Compulsory Certification (CCC)
requirements.description: CCC certificate and physical CCC mark.

rules.name: NMPA Cosmetic Notification & Filing (CSAR)
rules.title: NMPA Cosmetic Notification & Filing (CSAR)
rules.directive_code: Cosmetic Supervision and Administration Regulation (CSAR, State Council Decree No. 727)
rules.statute_citation: Cosmetic Supervision and Administration Regulation (CSAR, State Council Decree No. 727)
rules.expected_requirement: Imported ordinary cosmetics must be filed with NMPA and obtain an electronic filing voucher before commercial importation.
rules.explanation: Selling imported cosmetics in China without NMPA filing or appointment of a Domestic Responsible Person is an illegal act under CSAR.
rules.fix_suggestion: Appoint a Chinese domestic responsible person, compile cosmetic safety dossier, and complete online NMPA filing.

rules.name: PRC Advertising Law Medical Claim Ban on Consumer Products
rules.title: PRC Advertising Law Medical Claim Ban on Consumer Products
rules.directive_code: Advertising Law of the People's Republic of China, Article 17
rules.statute_citation: Advertising Law of the People's Republic of China, Article 17
rules.expected_requirement: Advertising for non-medical products must not involve disease treatment functions or use medical jargon that confuses goods with pharmaceuticals.
rules.explanation: Advertising cosmetics or wellness balms with claims to cure arthritis or heal chronic inflammation violates Article 17 with fines up to 1 million RMB.
rules.fix_suggestion: Remove therapeutic and curative terms. Limit claims to daily skin moisturizing and skin protection.

requirements.name: NMPA Claim Efficacy Substantiation
requirements.description: Efficacy evaluation summary published on NMPA portal.

rules.name: Mandatory Simplified Chinese Labeling Standard (GB 5296)
rules.title: Mandatory Simplified Chinese Labeling Standard (GB 5296)
rules.directive_code: GB 5296.1-2012 / GB 5296.3-2008 (Instructions for Use of Products of Consumer Interest)
rules.statute_citation: GB 5296.1-2012 / GB 5296.3-2008 (Instructions for Use of Products of Consumer Interest)
rules.expected_requirement: All imported consumer goods must have instructions and labels in standardized Simplified Chinese characters containing product name, manufacturer/importer address, net content, shelf life, and safety warnings.
rules.explanation: Goods entering general trade in China without Chinese labels cannot pass GACC customs inspection.
rules.fix_suggestion: Affix compliant Simplified Chinese label adhering to GB 5296 standards on the smallest retail packaging unit.

rules.name: GB 4806 Food Contact Materials Safety Standard
rules.title: GB 4806 Food Contact Materials Safety Standard
rules.directive_code: GB 4806.1-2016 / GB 4806.9-2016 (National Food Safety Standard for Food Contact Materials)
rules.statute_citation: GB 4806.1-2016 / GB 4806.9-2016 (National Food Safety Standard for Food Contact Materials)
rules.expected_requirement: Food contact cutting boards and kitchen utensils must comply with sensory requirements, migration limits, and declaration of compliance (DoC).
rules.explanation: Bamboo/wood cutting boards must not release sensory abnormalities, chemical migrants, or heavy metals exceeding GB 4806 limits.
rules.fix_suggestion: Verify compliance with GB 4806 testing and provide a formal Declaration of Compliance (DoC).

rules.name: GB 31241 Safety Standard for Lithium-ion Cells & Batteries
rules.title: GB 31241 Safety Standard for Lithium-ion Cells & Batteries
rules.directive_code: GB 31241-2022 (Lithium-ion Cells and Batteries Used in Portable Electronic Equipment)
rules.statute_citation: GB 31241-2022 (Lithium-ion Cells and Batteries Used in Portable Electronic Equipment)
rules.expected_requirement: Lithium-ion batteries in consumer electronic devices must meet GB 31241 testing and CCC certification requirements.
rules.explanation: GACC customs requires verified safety testing and CCC certificate for lithium-ion power banks and portable electronic batteries.
rules.fix_suggestion: Test battery cells against GB 31241 and obtain CCC certification for the power pack.
